name: Little Witch Fan Disc ~Chiisana Majo no Okuri Mono~
original_name: リトルウィッチファンディスク～ちいさな魔女の贈りもの～
source:
A fandisc featuring new stories for the three previously released Little Witch games' characters.

Various puzzles and minigames featuring the same characters are also included, as well as related fan materials.
translation:
这是一部Fan Disc，收录了此前三部Little Witch作品中各角色的新故事。

此外还包含以这些角色为主题的各种谜题与小游戏，以及相关的爱好者向附加内容。
